text: Based on the evidence from NASA FIRMS, there were no fires detected on the property (ASSET-F05) in the two weeks before 2026-10-04. The assessment covered the entire asset boundary and used data from multiple sensors (VIIRS_SNPP, VIIRS_NOAA20, VIIRS_NOAA21, and MODIS) from 2026-10-04 to 2026-11-03. No thermal anomalies or fires were detected during this period. However, it's important to note that small, short, cool, or cloud-obscured fires may not have been detected.
